claim: A new SEED_CHAINS list was added
Each chain has a title, short summary, and an ordered list of links
Each link names an existing transfer by id
Each link can include a via line explaining how the previous move leads to it
The backend format now accepts a chains array
Refreshes add or replace chains by id
Each chain block has a header containing the word Chain, the title, and a move count
Each chain block displays the summary text
Each chain block displays existing transfer cards in order
Every card in a chain has a numbered label showing its status
Status labels show one of: Interest, In Talks, or Done
Between cards an arrow displays the via text
On desktop the cards run left to right
On narrow screens the cards stack with downward arrows
Each chain appears as one full-width block above the board
A transfer that is in a chain is removed from the three columns
The column counts decrease to exclude transfers in chains
The count on the Transfers tab still includes transfers that are in chains
If any move in a chain matches the current search or league filter the whole chain is shown
Moves in a chain that do not match the current filter are faded rather than hidden
Links pointing at a transfer id that does not exist are skipped
A chain with fewer than two valid moves after filtering bad links is not shown
The app was rendered to HTML server-side and built without errors
The app was not viewed in a browser
The seed chain shows up with 3 steps
The seed chain shows up with 2 connectors
Gordon's card appears once instead of twice
A sample chain named The Gordon domino was added
The Gordon domino chain consists of Gordon to Barcelona, Bremer to Bayern, and Maignan to Juventus
The Bayern story in the existing data says With Anthony Gordon gone to Barça Bayern pivot to defence
The Juventus story in the existing data says they must sell to buy and need a goalkeeper
No sources report the Gordon domino as a single chain
All changes are in TransferDesk.jsx
